title: Adding sidemen after San Antonio and Dallas
summary: Albert lists musicians added as the band grew, including Philander Tiller, bassists, Harold Holmes the arranger.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now when you got to San Antonio, to the Chicken Plantation, did you add any part of him?
Not right then. When we went to Shatnerland we got Philander Tiller. And we had Arthur Durably, Philander Tiller, Amore Cattrack and Hall.
So you got a real close song, didn't you?

That was the first bass song. And then when we went up a little further, when we added Geechee Robinson, another drum roll. We had Nick Turner, another bass record. I had Jimmy Johnson on the string bass. And I had Nick Turner on the Suze for MWM on the drum roll. And then later on I added Harold Holmes, who's now in Canada, who did most of my arranging. And as we traveled over the country, I added here, subtracted, added and subtracted.
